Plot cognitive interview problems per item

Source: R/interview.R
gg_interview.Rd

gg_interview() draws one heatmap of items (rows) by stage (columns), coloured by the share of interviews in which the coder found a problem: Pale is none, red is most. Flagged items (see summarise_interviews()) are marked with an asterisk after their name, and the items are sorted with the most problems at the top.

Usage

gg_interview(x, flag = 0.3, max_items = 40)

Arguments

x

a result of cognitive_interview() or summarise_interviews().

flag

passed to summarise_interviews() when x is not yet a summary.

max_items

show at most this many items (those with the most problems).

Value

A ggplot.

See also

cognitive_interview(), summarise_interviews()

Examples

items <- data.frame(item = c("q1", "q2", "q3"),
                    statement = c("I never don't worry.", "I keep my promises.",
                                  "I like parties and quiet evenings."))
iv <- cognitive_interview(sc_instrument(items), sc_model("mock"),
                          c("You are 20 years old.", "You are 70 years old."),
                          interviews = 3)
#> 18 interviews (1 model x 2 personas x 3 items x 3 interviews): 54 requests.
gg_interview(iv)
